114	class Audit:
115	    def __init__(self, idea, audit_id, llm, tracer, root, cache_dir, fetchers, fault, resume, provider):
116	        self.audit_id, self.llm, self.tracer = audit_id, llm, tracer
117	        self.root, self.cache_dir, self.fetchers = Path(root), Path(cache_dir), fetchers
118	        self.fault, self.provider = fault, provider
119	        self.dir = self.root / audit_id
120	        self.dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
121	        state_path = self.dir / "state.json"
122	        if resume:
123	            self.state = State.load(state_path)
124	            self.log = EventLog.resume(self.dir / "events.jsonl", audit_id)
125	        else:
126	            if state_path.exists() or (self.dir / "events.jsonl").exists():
127	                raise AuditError("audit %r already exists: use --resume %s or a new --id" % (audit_id, audit_id))
128	            self.state = State.new(state_path, audit_id, idea)
129	            self.log = EventLog(self.dir / "events.jsonl", audit_id)
130	        self.idea = self.state.data["idea"]
131	        self.budget = Budget(self.state)
132	        self.step = "start"
133	        self.data = {}           # prices, market, features, iv, earnings (in memory only)
134	        tracer.on_span = self._on_span
135	
136	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ events from spans and recoveries
137	    def _on_span(self, rec):
138	        if rec.get("kind") != "llm":
139	            return
140	        agent = rec["name"]
141	        cost = self.state.data["cost"]
142	        cost["prompt_tokens"] += int(rec.get("prompt_tokens", 0))
143	        cost["completion_tokens"] += int(rec.get("completion_tokens", 0))
144	        cost["usd"] += float(rec.get("cost", 0.0))
145	        self.state.save()
146	        self.log.emit("llm_call", agent, {"model": rec.get("model"), "prompt_tokens": int(rec.get("prompt_tokens", 0)),
147	                                          "completion_tokens": int(rec.get("completion_tokens", 0)),
148	                                          "cost_usd": float(rec.get("cost", 0.0)),
149	                                          "latency_ms": int(1000 * float(rec.get("duration", 0.0)))})
150	        if int(rec.get("attempts", 1) or 1) > 1:
151	            self.recovered(agent, "empty or off-schema LLM reply from the %s" % agent, "retried the call once")
152	
153	    def recovered(self, agent, failed, action):
154	        injected = self.fault is not None and not self.state.data.get("injected_used")
155	        if injected:
156	            self.state.data["injected_used"] = True
157	        entry = {"failed": failed, "action": action, "injected": injected}
158	        self.state.data["recoveries"].append(entry)
159	        self.state.save()
160	        self.log.emit("recovered", agent, entry)
161	
162	    def call(self, role, fn, *args):
163	        self.budget.check(role)
164	        self.budget.count()
165	        return fn(self.llm, *args)
166	
167	    def agent(self, name, step):
168	        """Context manager emitting agent_started / agent_finished with a summary set by the caller."""
169	        audit = self
170	
171	        class _Ctx:
172	            def __enter__(self_):
173	                self_.t0, self_.summary = time.time(), None
174	                self_.span = audit.tracer.span("agent", name, agent=name, step=step, audit_id=audit.audit_id)
175	                self_.rec = self_.span.__enter__()
176	                audit.log.emit("agent_started", name, {"step": step})
177	                return self_
178	
179	            def __exit__(self_, exc_type, exc, tb):
180	                summary = _clean(self_.summary) if self_.summary is not None else None
181	                self_.rec["output"] = summary
182	                audit.log.emit("agent_finished", name, {"step": step, "status": "error" if exc else "ok",
183	                                                        "duration_ms": int(1000 * (time.time() - self_.t0)),
184	                                                        "summary": summary})
185	                self_.span.__exit__(exc_type, exc, tb)
186	                return False
187	
188	        return _Ctx()
189	
190	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- steps
191	    def run(self):
192	        with self.tracer.span("workflow", "audit", audit_id=self.audit_id, provider=self.provider):
193	            return self._run()
194	
195	    def _run(self):
196	        if "started" not in self.state.data:
197	            self.log.emit("audit_started", None, {"idea": self.idea, "trace_id": getattr(self.tracer, "trace_id", None),
198	                                                  "llm_budget": LLM_BUDGET, "fault": self.fault, "provider": self.provider})
199	            self.state.data["started"] = _now()
200	            self.state.save()
201	        try:
202	            self.step = "plan"
203	            if not self.state.done("plan"):
204	                self.step_plan()
205	            plan = self.state.result("plan")["plan"]
206	            cannot = bool(plan.get("refused") or plan.get("invalid_twice") or plan.get("core_trigger_tested") is False)
207	            if not cannot:
208	                self.step = "data"
209	                self.step_data()
210	                self.step = "backtest"
211	                if not self.state.done("backtest"):
212	                    self.step_backtest()
213	                self.step = "critique"
214	                if not self.state.done("critique"):
215	                    self.step_critique()
216	            self.step = "verdict"
217	            if not self.state.done("verdict"):
218	                self.step_verdict(cannot)
219	            self.step = "report"
220	            if not self.state.done("report"):
221	                self.step_report()
222	        except checks.LeakageError as e:
223	            self.log.emit("error", None, {"step": self.step, "message": "leakage check failed: %s" % e})
224	            raise AuditError("leakage check failed: %s" % e) from e
225	        except Exception as e:
226	            self.log.emit("error", None, {"step": self.step, "message": "%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e)})
227	            raise
228	        v = self.state.result("verdict")
229	        return {"verdict": v, "report_path": str(self.dir / "report.md"), "events_path": str(self.dir / "events.jsonl"),
230	                "state": self.state.data}
231	
232	    def step_plan(self):
233	        with self.agent("planner", "plan") as a:
234	            raw = self.call("planner", agents.run_planner, self.idea, None)
235	            raws = [raw]
236	            plan, err = validate(raw)
237	            errors = []
238	            if err:
239	                errors.append(err)
240	                raw2 = self.call("planner", agents.run_planner, self.idea, err)
241	                raws.append(raw2)
242	                plan, err2 = validate(raw2)
243	                if err2:
244	                    errors.append(err2)
245	                    plan = {"refused": False, "invalid_twice": True, "errors": errors}
246	            frozen = _clean(plan)
247	            result = {"plan": frozen, "hash": plan_hash(frozen), "raw_replies": _clean(raws), "errors": errors,
248	                      "what_tested": what_tested(frozen) if not frozen.get("invalid_twice") else "no valid plan"}
249	            a.summary = {"plan": frozen, "plan_hash": result["hash"], "what_tested": result["what_tested"]}
250	        self.state.finish("plan", result)
251	
252	    def _tool(self, name, args, fn):
253	        self.log.emit("tool_called", "researcher", {"tool": name, "args": args})
254	        t0 = time.time()
255	        with self.tracer.span("tool", name, agent="researcher", step="data", audit_id=self.audit_id) as rec:
256	            rec["input"] = args
257	            try:
258	                out = fn()
259	            except Exception as e:
260	                self.log.emit("tool_result", "researcher", {"tool": name, "ok": False, "duration_ms": int(1000 * (time.time() - t0)),
261	                                                           "summary": "%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e)})
262	                raise
263	            rec["output"] = out[1]
264	        self.log.emit("tool_result", "researcher", {"tool": name, "ok": True, "duration_ms": int(1000 * (time.time() - t0)),
265	                                                   "summary": out[1]})
266	        return out[0]
267	
268	    def step_data(self):
269	        plan = self.state.result("plan")["plan"]
270	        tickers = GROUPS[plan["universe_group"]]
271	        straddle = plan["family"].startswith("straddle")
272	        quiet = self.state.done("data")             # on resume: reload data without replaying the events
273	        emit = (lambda *a, **k: None) if quiet else self.log.emit
274	        ctx = self.agent("researcher", "data") if not quiet else None
275	        if ctx:
276	            ctx.__enter__()
277	        try:
278	            def tool(name, args, fn):
279	                return fn()[0] if quiet else self._tool(name, args, fn)
280	
281	            def get_prices():
282	                prices, skipped = self.fetchers["prices"](tickers, self.cache_dir)
283	                return (prices, skipped), "%d tickers with prices, %d skipped" % (len([t for t in prices if t not in MARKET]), len(skipped))
284	
285	            prices, skipped = tool("get_prices", {"group": plan["universe_group"], "tickers": len(tickers)}, get_prices)
286	            emit("data_progress", "researcher", {"what": "prices", "percent": 33})
287	
288	            def get_earnings():
289	                e = self.fetchers["earnings"]([t for t in tickers if t in prices], self.cache_dir)
290	                return e, "earnings dates for %d tickers" % sum(1 for v in e.values() if v)
291	
292	            earnings = tool("get_earnings_dates", {"tickers": len(tickers)}, get_earnings)
293	            emit("data_progress", "researcher", {"what": "earnings", "percent": 66})
294	            iv = None
295	            if straddle:
296	                def get_iv():
297	                    # One fetch for all 50 tickers: DoltHub is queried per date window, so the cost is the same
298	                    # whatever the group, and the cache then serves every later audit.
299	                    df = self.fetchers["iv"](ALL, self.cache_dir,
300	                                             on_recovered=lambda f, a: self.recovered("researcher", f, a),
301	                                             fault_first_timeout=(self.fault == "dolthub_timeout"))
302	                    df = df[df["ticker"].isin([t for t in tickers if t in prices])]
303	                    return df, "%d implied-vol rows" % len(df)
304	
305	                iv = tool("get_implied_vol", {"tickers": len(tickers)}, get_iv)
306	            market = {m: prices[m] for m in MARKET if m in prices}
307	            universe = {t: df for t, df in prices.items() if t not in MARKET}
308	
309	            def features():
310	                f = build_features(universe, market, iv, earnings)
311	                return f, "%d ticker-days with features" % len(f)
312	
313	            feats = tool("build_features", {"tickers": len(universe)}, features)
314	            emit("data_progress", "researcher", {"what": "features", "percent": 100})
315	            cov = coverage_of(universe, skipped, iv, earnings)
316	            self.data.update(prices=universe, market=market, features=feats, iv=iv, earnings=earnings, coverage=cov)
317	            if ctx:
318	                ctx.summary = {"coverage": {"tickers": len(universe), "skipped": skipped,
319	                                            "iv_rows": cov["iv_rows"], "tickers_without_earnings": cov["tickers_without_earnings"]}}
320	        except Exception:
321	            if ctx:
322	                ctx.__exit__(*__import__("sys").exc_info())
323	            raise
324	        if ctx:
325	            ctx.__exit__(None, None, None)
326	        if not quiet:
327	            self.state.finish("data", {"coverage": _clean(cov)})
328	
329	    def step_backtest(self):
330	        plan = self.state.result("plan")["plan"]
331	        d = self.data
332	        prices, feats, earnings = d["prices"], d["features"], d["earnings"]
333	        calendar = d["market"]["SPY"].index
334	        with self.agent("mathematician", "backtest") as a:
335	            base, drops, trades = {}, {}, {}
336	            for split in ("train", "validation"):
337	                t, dr = backtest.run_backtest(prices, feats, plan, earnings, split)
338	                trades[split], drops[split] = t, dr
339	                base[split] = checks.stats(t, calendar)
340	            setups_val = backtest.select_setups(feats, plan, "validation")
341	            checks.assert_no_leakage(setups_val["date"])
342	            for t in trades.values():
343	                checks.assert_no_leakage(t["entry_date"])
344	            dates_max = max([setups_val["date"].max()] + [t["entry_date"].max() for t in trades.values() if len(t)]) if len(setups_val) else None
345	
346	            no_cond = dict(plan, conditions={})
347	            bl_trades = {s: backtest.run_backtest(prices, feats, no_cond, earnings, s)[0] for s in ("train", "validation")}
348	            baseline = {s: checks.stats(bl_trades[s], calendar) for s in bl_trades}
349	            baseline["paired_ci_low"] = checks.paired_lower_bound(trades["validation"]["entry_date"], trades["validation"]["ret"],
350	                                                                  bl_trades["validation"]["entry_date"], bl_trades["validation"]["ret"], calendar)
351	            rate = len(trades["validation"]) / len(bl_trades["validation"]) if len(bl_trades["validation"]) else 0.0
352	            rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
353	            rand = {s: checks.stats(bl_trades[s][rng.random(len(bl_trades[s])) < rate], calendar) for s in bl_trades}
354	
355	            stricter = None
356	            if plan["family"].startswith("straddle"):
357	                st = {s: backtest.run_backtest(prices, feats, plan, earnings, s, stricter=True)[0] for s in ("train", "validation")}
358	                stricter = {s: checks.stats(st[s], calendar) for s in st}
359	            all_trades = pd.concat([trades["train"], trades["validation"]], ignore_index=True)
360	            tail = checks.tail_risk(all_trades, plan["family"], float(trades["validation"]["ret"].sum()), calendar)
361	
362	            payload = {"run": "base", "train": base["train"], "validation": base["validation"],
363	                       "baseline": dict(baseline["validation"], paired_ci_low=baseline["paired_ci_low"]),
364	                       "equity_train": checks.equity_curve(trades["train"]),
365	                       "equity_validation": checks.equity_curve(trades["validation"]),
366	                       "histogram": checks.histogram(all_trades["ret"])}
367	            self.log.emit("backtest_result", "mathematician", _clean(payload))
368	            if stricter:
369	                self.log.emit("backtest_result", "mathematician", _clean({
370	                    "run": "stricter_cost", "train": stricter["train"], "validation": stricter["validation"],
371	                    "baseline": payload["baseline"], "equity_train": [], "equity_validation": [], "histogram": {}}))
372	            result = {"base": base, "baseline": baseline, "random_baseline": rand, "stricter": stricter, "tail": tail,
373	                      "drops": drops, "dates_max": dates_max.date().isoformat() if dates_max is not None else None,
374	                      "n_trades": {s: int(len(t)) for s, t in trades.items()}}
375	            a.summary = {"validation_n": base["validation"]["n"], "validation_mean": base["validation"]["mean"]}
376	        self.state.finish("backtest", _clean(result))
377	
378	    def _results(self):
379	        plan_r = self.state.result("plan")
380	        r = {"plan": plan_r["plan"], "what_tested": plan_r["what_tested"], "coverage": self.state.result("data")["coverage"]
381	             if self.state.done("data") else {}}
382	        r.update(self.state.result("backtest"))
383	        r["followup_downgrades"] = []
384	        if self.state.done("critique"):
385	            r["checks"] = self.state.result("critique")["checks"]
386	        return r

388	    def step_critique(self):
389	        results = self._results()
390	        window_count = report_mod.registry_count(self.root / "registry.jsonl")
391	        coded = checks.coded_checks(results, window_count)
392	        with self.agent("naysayer", "critique") as a:
393	            for c in coded:
394	                self.log.emit("check_result", "naysayer", _clean(c))
395	            results["checks"] = coded
396	            budget_hit, critique, doubts = False, "", []
397	            try:
398	                out = self.call("naysayer", agents.run_naysayer, agents.naysayer_context(results))
399	                critique, doubts = out["critique"], out["doubts"]
400	            except BudgetExceeded as e:
401	                budget_hit, critique = True, "LLM call cap hit before the critique: %s" % e
402	            except LLMError as e:
403	                critique = "Naysayer call failed: %s" % e
404	            a.summary = {"doubts": doubts, "critique": critique}
405	        self.state.finish("critique", {"checks": _clean(coded), "critique": critique, "doubts": doubts,
406	                                       "budget_hit": budget_hit, "window_count": window_count})
407	
408	    def step_verdict(self, cannot):
409	        if cannot:
410	            results = {"plan": self.state.result("plan")["plan"]}
411	        else:
412	            results = self._results()
413	        v = verdict_mod.decide(results)
414	        self.log.emit("verdict", None, _clean(v))
415	        self.state.finish("verdict", _clean(v))

417	    def step_report(self):
418	        plan_r, v = self.state.result("plan"), self.state.result("verdict")
419	        plan = plan_r["plan"]
420	        bt = self.state.result("backtest") if self.state.done("backtest") else {}
421	        cr = self.state.result("critique") if self.state.done("critique") else {}
422	        cost = self.state.data["cost"]
423	        group = plan.get("universe_group")
424	        ctx = {"idea": self.idea, "audit_id": self.audit_id, "plan": plan, "plan_hash": plan_r["hash"],
425	               "what_tested": plan_r["what_tested"], "verdict": v,
426	               "coverage": self.state.result("data")["coverage"] if self.state.done("data") else {},
427	               "drops": bt.get("drops", {}), "base": bt.get("base", {}), "baseline": bt.get("baseline", {}),
428	               "random_baseline": bt.get("random_baseline", {}), "stricter": bt.get("stricter"), "tail": bt.get("tail", {}),
429	               "checks": cr.get("checks", []), "followups": [], "window_count": cr.get("window_count", 0),
430	               "critique": cr.get("critique"), "prose": None, "recoveries": self.state.data["recoveries"],
431	               "cost": {"calls": self.state.data["llm_calls"], "prompt_tokens": cost["prompt_tokens"],
432	                        "completion_tokens": cost["completion_tokens"], "usd": cost["usd"]},
433	               "trace_id": getattr(self.tracer, "trace_id", None),
434	               "small_group_note": ("%s has %d tickers: usually inconclusive for lack of trades" % (group, len(GROUPS[group]))
435	                                    if group in SMALL_GROUPS else None),
436	               "earnings_caveat": any(f.startswith("earnings") or f == "days_since_earnings" for f in (plan.get("conditions") or {})),
437	               "fake_llm": self.provider == "fake", "budget_hit": bool(cr.get("budget_hit")),
438	               "fault_note": ("Fault requested: %s, but no DoltHub fetch happens for %s, so nothing was injected."
439	                              % (self.fault, plan.get("family"))
440	                              if self.fault == "dolthub_timeout" and not str(plan.get("family", "")).startswith("straddle")
441	                              and not self.state.data["recoveries"] else None)}
442	        with self.agent("reporter", "report") as a:
443	            prose = None
444	            if not plan.get("refused"):
445	                try:
446	                    text = self.call("reporter", agents.run_reporter, report_mod.render(ctx))
447	                    prose = text if report_mod.prose_ok(text) else None
448	                except (LLMError, BudgetExceeded):
449	                    prose = None
450	            ctx["cost"]["calls"] = self.state.data["llm_calls"]
451	            ctx["cost"].update({k: cost[k] for k in ("prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens", "usd")})
452	            ctx["prose"] = prose
453	            path = self.dir / "report.md"

1	"""Verdict rules (AUDITOR_SPEC section 7), in code. LLMs explain but cannot override."""
2	
3	MIN_N, MIN_BLOCKS = 30, 6
4	CORE_REASON = "core of the idea not testable with available data"
5	
6	
7	def decide(results):
8	    """-> {"verdict", "reason", "headline", "downgrades"} from the orchestrator's results dict."""
9	    plan = results["plan"]
10	    if plan.get("refused"):
11	        return _out("cannot_audit", "refused")
12	    if plan.get("invalid_twice"):
13	        return _out("cannot_audit", "no valid plan")
14	    if plan.get("core_trigger_tested") is False:
15	        return _out("cannot_audit", CORE_REASON)
16	
17	    val, train = results["base"]["validation"], results["base"]["train"]
18	    baseline = results["baseline"]
19	    headline = {"n": val["n"], "mean": val["mean"], "ci_low": val["ci_low"], "paired_ci_low": baseline.get("paired_ci_low")}
20	    if val["n"] < MIN_N:
21	        return _out("inconclusive", "not enough evidence: validation n < %d" % MIN_N, headline)
22	    if val["blocks"] < MIN_BLOCKS:
23	        return _out("inconclusive", "not enough evidence: trades fall in fewer than %d distinct 10-trading-day blocks" % MIN_BLOCKS, headline)
24	    if val["mean"] <= 0:
25	        return _out("kill", "validation mean <= 0 with enough evidence", headline)
26	
27	    failed = []
28	    if not val["ci_low"] > 0:
29	        failed.append("lower bound of the validation mean is not above 0")
30	    paired = baseline.get("paired_ci_low")
31	    if paired is None or not paired > 0:
32	        failed.append("paired lower bound against the no-condition baseline is not above 0")
33	    if not train["mean"] > baseline["train"]["mean"]:
34	        failed.append("train mean is not above the train baseline mean")
35	    if plan["family"].startswith("straddle"):
36	        stricter = results.get("stricter") or {}
37	        s_val = stricter.get("validation") if stricter else None
38	        if not (s_val and s_val.get("ci_low", 0) > 0):
39	            failed.append("fails the stricter-cost check")
40	    if failed:
41	        return _out("inconclusive", "positive but not convincing: " + "; ".join(failed), headline)
42	
43	    downgrades = []
44	    if results.get("tail", {}).get("fails"):
45	        downgrades.append({"cause": "tail risk", "from": "promising", "to": "inconclusive"})
46	    for d in results.get("followup_downgrades") or []:
47	        downgrades.append({"cause": d["cause"], "from": "promising", "to": "inconclusive"})
48	    if downgrades:
49	        return _out("inconclusive", "promising on the base rules, downgraded: " + "; ".join(d["cause"] for d in downgrades), headline, downgrades)
50	    return _out("promising", "all rules passed", headline)
51	
52	
53	def _out(verdict, reason, headline=None, downgrades=None):
54	    return {"verdict": verdict, "reason": reason, "headline": headline or {}, "downgrades": downgrades or []}

"""The auditor's LLM agents (AUDITOR_SPEC section 4): Planner, Naysayer, Reporter. Prompts and reply
schemas live here; every call goes through the llm(agent, system, prompt, schema, **tags) wrapper."""
import json
import re

from .plan import EXIT_RANGES, FEATURES, MAX_CONDITIONS, SCHEMA as PLAN_SCHEMA
from .universe import GROUPS

FEATURE_FORMULAS = {
    "ret_1d/ret_5d/ret_10d/ret_20d": "adjusted close today / adjusted close N trading days ago - 1",
    "vol_20d": "standard deviation of the last 20 daily returns",
    "close_to_ma50/close_to_ma200": "adjusted close today / mean adjusted close of the last 50 or 200 days",
    "spy_ret_5d/spy_ret_20d": "SPY close today / SPY close N trading days ago - 1",
    "spy_close_to_ma50": "SPY close / its 50-day mean",
    "vix_level": "VIX close", "vix_chg_5d": "VIX today / VIX 5 trading days ago - 1",
    "rel_ret_20d": "ret_20d - spy_ret_20d",
    "vol_ratio_5d/vol_ratio_20d": "today's volume / mean volume of the previous 5 or 20 days",
    "iv": "implied volatility (straddles only)", "hv": "historical volatility (straddles only)",
    "iv_hv_ratio": "iv / hv (straddles only)", "iv_minus_rv20": "iv - vol_20d x sqrt(252) (straddles only)",
    "earnings_within_10d": "1 if an earnings report falls in the next 10 trading days, else 0",
    "days_since_earnings": "trading days since the last earnings report",
}

PLANNER_SYSTEM = (
    "You are the Planner of the Strategy Auditor, a paper-trading research tool that tests trading ideas on "
    "historical data and returns a verdict. This is research, not financial advice. Translate the user's idea into "
    "one AuditPlan, or refuse it.\n\n"
    "Refuse (refuse.is_refused = true, with the reason) any idea that involves market manipulation, trading on "
    "non-public information, or anything illegal. When refusing, the other fields may be empty.\n\n"
    "Families (field family, pick exactly one):\n"
    "- stock_long: buy at the close on days that satisfy the conditions; exit at a target gain, a stop loss, or after a "
    "horizon in trading days (exit.target_pct and stop_pct between %s and %s as fractions, horizon_days between %d and %d).\n"
    "- straddle_buy: buy an at-the-money straddle at the close on days that satisfy the conditions; hold 10 days.\n"
    "- straddle_sell: sell the same straddle; hold 10 days. Exit is ignored for straddles.\n\n"
    "Universe groups (field universe_group: pick exactly one name, never list tickers): %s.\n\n"
    "Conditions (field conditions): 0 to %d conditions, each {feature, op, value} with op in >, <, >=, <= and a numeric value, one per "
    "feature. Features and formulas: %s. Implied-vol features are only allowed for straddles. You never see dates; "
    "the backtest decides the windows.\n\n"
    "State every reading you made in assumptions (for example \"'uptrend' read as close above its 200-day average\"). "
    "List in not_tested every part of the idea that cannot be expressed with these families and features (for example "
    "news sentiment, intraday data, short selling, crypto). If the part of the idea that triggers a trade cannot be "
    "expressed, set core_trigger_tested to false. Keep hypothesis to one sentence. Reply only with the JSON object."
) % (EXIT_RANGES["target_pct"][0], EXIT_RANGES["target_pct"][1], EXIT_RANGES["horizon_days"][0],
     EXIT_RANGES["horizon_days"][1],
     "; ".join("%s = %s" % (g, ", ".join(t)) for g, t in GROUPS.items()), MAX_CONDITIONS,
     "; ".join("%s: %s" % kv for kv in FEATURE_FORMULAS.items()))

NAYSAYER_SYSTEM = (
    "You are the Naysayer of the Strategy Auditor, a paper-trading research tool. Coded checks and verdict rules have "
    "already run; you cannot change the verdict or any number. Your job is to state, in plain language, the doubts a "
    "careful reader should have about this backtest: thin evidence, decay from train to validation, a result the "
    "no-condition baseline explains, cost realism, tail risk, data drops, and anything that looks like curve fitting. "
    "You are given summary statistics only: no tickers and no dates. Do not use outside knowledge of markets or "
    "specific stocks. No financial advice, no position sizing. Reply with a short critique (3 to 6 sentences) and a "
    "list of specific doubts."
)
NAYSAYER_SCHEMA = {"type": "object", "properties": {"critique": {"type": "string"},
                                                    "doubts": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}},
                   "required": ["critique", "doubts"]}

REPORTER_SYSTEM = (
    "You are the Reporter of the Strategy Auditor. You are given the finished report, written by code. Add 2 to 5 "
    "sentences of plain-language explanation of what was tested and what the numbers mean for a hobby trader. You "
    "must not change or restate any number differently, must not change the verdict, must not recommend buying or "
    "selling, must not give position sizes, and must not use the phrases 'will profit', 'guaranteed', 'risk-free', "
    "'we recommend', 'you should buy', 'you should sell' or 'sure thing'. This is not financial advice."
)
REPORTER_SCHEMA = {"type": "object", "properties": {"prose": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["prose"]}

_DATE = re.compile(r"\b(?:19|20)\d\d(?:-\d\d(?:-\d\d)?)?\b")


def run_planner(llm, idea, fix_reason):
    """-> raw Planner reply. fix_reason is the validator's message after an invalid plan (one fix allowed)."""
    body = {"idea": idea}
    if fix_reason:
        body["previous_plan_was_invalid"] = fix_reason
        body["instruction"] = "Return a corrected plan that fixes this problem."
    return llm("planner", PLANNER_SYSTEM, json.dumps(body), PLAN_SCHEMA, step="plan")


def naysayer_context(results):
    """What the Naysayer sees: summary statistics only, with dates masked and no tickers."""
    ctx = {"what_tested": results.get("what_tested"),
           "base": results.get("base"), "baseline": results.get("baseline"),
           "stricter": results.get("stricter"), "tail": results.get("tail"),
           "checks": [{"check": c["check"], "passed": c["passed"], "note": c["note"]} for c in results.get("checks") or []],
           "drops": results.get("drops")}
    return _mask(ctx)


def _mask(value):
    """Replace dates/years inside string values only; numbers and structure are untouched."""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return _DATE.sub("[date]", value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: _mask(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [_mask(v) for v in value]
    if hasattr(value, "item"):
        return value.item()
    return value


def run_naysayer(llm, context):
    """-> {"critique", "doubts"} (the only Naysayer LLM call in M1: the final critique)."""
    out = llm("naysayer", NAYSAYER_SYSTEM, json.dumps(context), NAYSAYER_SCHEMA, step="critique")
    return {"critique": str(out.get("critique", "")), "doubts": [str(d) for d in out.get("doubts", []) or []]}


def run_reporter(llm, report_md):
    """-> prose string (the reserved 8th call)."""
    out = llm("reporter", REPORTER_SYSTEM, report_md, REPORTER_SCHEMA, step="report")
    return str(out.get("prose", ""))

1	"""Statistics and coded checks (AUDITOR_SPEC section 7).
2	
3	bootstrap_mean: block bootstrap over 10-trading-day blocks of entry dates, 2000 resamples, reporting the 2.5th
4	and 97.5th percentiles of the mean. paired_lower_bound resamples the same blocks for two trade sets.
5	"""
6	import numpy as np
7	import pandas as pd
8	
9	BLOCK_DAYS = 10
10	N_BOOT = 2000
11	VALIDATION_END = pd.Timestamp("2026-06-30")
12	MIN_N, MIN_BLOCKS = 30, 6
13	FIVE_PCT_LINE = ("About 5% of plans with no real edge pass this test by chance; testing many variants of one "
14	                 "idea raises that.")
15	
16	
17	class LeakageError(AssertionError):
18	    pass
19	
20	
21	def assert_no_leakage(dates, cutoff=VALIDATION_END):
22	    """Raise LeakageError if any setup/feature date is after the validation window."""
23	    dates = pd.to_datetime(pd.Series(dates))
24	    if len(dates) and dates.max() > cutoff:
25	        raise LeakageError("date %s is after the cutoff %s" % (dates.max().date(), cutoff.date()))
26	
27	
28	def _positions(dates, calendar):
29	    return np.asarray(calendar.searchsorted(pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)), dtype=int)
30	
31	
32	def block_ids(dates, calendar):
33	    return _positions(dates, calendar) // BLOCK_DAYS
34	
35	
36	def _block_sums(dates, returns, calendar, block_index):
37	    """Per-block (sum, count) arrays aligned to block_index (a dict block id -> position)."""
38	    sums, counts = np.zeros(len(block_index)), np.zeros(len(block_index))
39	    for b, r in zip(block_ids(dates, calendar), np.asarray(returns, dtype=float)):
40	        sums[block_index[b]] += r
41	        counts[block_index[b]] += 1
42	    return sums, counts
43	
44	
45	def bootstrap_mean(dates, returns, calendar, n_boot=N_BOOT, seed=0):
46	    """(2.5th, 97.5th percentile) of the mean under a block bootstrap. (nan, nan) with no trades."""
47	    returns = np.asarray(returns, dtype=float)
48	    if len(returns) == 0:
49	        return (float("nan"), float("nan"))
50	    blocks = sorted(set(block_ids(dates, calendar)))
51	    if len(blocks) < 2:
52	        m = float(returns.mean())
53	        return (m, m)
54	    index = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(blocks)}
55	    sums, counts = _block_sums(dates, returns, calendar, index)
56	    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
57	    picks = rng.integers(0, len(blocks), size=(n_boot, len(blocks)))
58	    means = sums[picks].sum(axis=1) / counts[picks].sum(axis=1)
59	    return (float(np.percentile(means, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(means, 97.5)))
60	
61	
62	def paired_lower_bound(dates_a, ret_a, dates_b, ret_b, calendar, n_boot=N_BOOT, seed=0):
63	    """2.5th percentile of (mean_a - mean_b) over the same resampled blocks (the union of both block sets)."""
64	    ret_a, ret_b = np.asarray(ret_a, dtype=float), np.asarray(ret_b, dtype=float)
65	    if len(ret_a) == 0 or len(ret_b) == 0:
66	        return float("nan")
67	    blocks = sorted(set(block_ids(dates_a, calendar)) | set(block_ids(dates_b, calendar)))
68	    index = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(blocks)}
69	    sa, ca = _block_sums(dates_a, ret_a, calendar, index)
70	    sb, cb = _block_sums(dates_b, ret_b, calendar, index)
71	    if len(blocks) < 2:
72	        return float(ret_a.mean() - ret_b.mean())
73	    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
74	    picks = rng.integers(0, len(blocks), size=(n_boot, len(blocks)))
75	    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
76	        diff = sa[picks].sum(axis=1) / ca[picks].sum(axis=1) - sb[picks].sum(axis=1) / cb[picks].sum(axis=1)
77	    diff = diff[np.isfinite(diff)]
78	    return float(np.percentile(diff, 2.5)) if len(diff) else float("nan")
79	
80	
81	def worst_window(trades, calendar):
82	    """Worst sum of trade returns over any 10-trading-day window of entry dates (0 with no trades)."""
83	    if len(trades) == 0:
84	        return 0.0
85	    pos = _positions(trades["entry_date"], calendar)
86	    daily = np.zeros(pos.max() + BLOCK_DAYS + 1)
87	    np.add.at(daily, pos, trades["ret"].to_numpy(float))
88	    rolling = np.convolve(daily, np.ones(BLOCK_DAYS), mode="valid")
89	    return float(min(rolling.min(), 0.0))
90	
91	
92	def stats(trades, calendar):
93	    if len(trades) == 0:
94	        return {"n": 0, "blocks": 0, "win_rate": 0.0, "mean": 0.0, "median": 0.0, "ci_low": 0.0, "ci_high": 0.0,
95	                "worst_trade": 0.0, "worst_window": 0.0}
96	    r = trades["ret"].to_numpy(float)
97	    lo, hi = bootstrap_mean(trades["entry_date"], r, calendar)
98	    return {"n": int(len(r)), "blocks": int(len(set(block_ids(trades["entry_date"], calendar)))),
99	            "win_rate": float((r > 0).mean()), "mean": float(r.mean()), "median": float(np.median(r)),
100	            "ci_low": lo, "ci_high": hi, "worst_trade": float(r.min()), "worst_window": worst_window(trades, calendar)}
101	
102	
103	def equity_curve(trades, max_points=300):
104	    """[[entry date iso, cumulative return], ...] by entry date, downsampled evenly to at most max_points."""
105	    if len(trades) == 0:
106	        return []
107	    t = trades.sort_values("entry_date")
108	    cum = t["ret"].to_numpy(float).cumsum()
109	    dates = [d.date().isoformat() for d in pd.DatetimeIndex(t["entry_date"])]
110	    idx = np.unique(np.linspace(0, len(cum) - 1, min(max_points, len(cum))).round().astype(int))
111	    return [[dates[i], float(cum[i])] for i in idx]
112	
113	
114	def histogram(returns, bins=20):
115	    r = np.asarray(returns, dtype=float)
116	    r = r[np.isfinite(r)]
117	    if len(r) == 0:
118	        return {"edges": [], "counts": []}
119	    p1, p99 = np.percentile(r, 1), np.percentile(r, 99)
120	    if p99 <= p1:
121	        p99 = p1 + 1e-9
122	    edges = np.linspace(p1, p99, bins + 1)
123	    inner, _ = np.histogram(r[(r >= p1) & (r <= p99)], bins=edges)
124	    counts = [int((r < p1).sum())] + [int(c) for c in inner] + [int((r > p99).sum())]
125	    return {"edges": [float(e) for e in edges], "counts": counts}
126	
127	
128	def tail_risk(all_trades, family, validation_total_gain, calendar=None):
129	    """Worst trade and worst 10-day window on train plus validation; the straddle_sell downgrade rule."""
130	    calendar = calendar if calendar is not None else pd.DatetimeIndex(sorted(set(pd.DatetimeIndex(all_trades["entry_date"])))) if len(all_trades) else pd.DatetimeIndex([])
131	    if len(all_trades) == 0:
132	        return {"worst_trade": 0.0, "worst_window": 0.0, "fails": False}
133	    r = all_trades["ret"].to_numpy(float)
134	    out = {"worst_trade": float(r.min()), "worst_window": worst_window(all_trades, calendar), "fails": False}
135	    if family == "straddle_sell":
136	        premium = all_trades["premium"].to_numpy(float)
137	        avg = float(premium.mean()) if len(premium) else 0.0
138	        loss_pct = r * premium                        # return x premium share = % of stock price
139	        out["worst_trade_pct"] = float(loss_pct.min())
140	        out["worst_trade_premiums"] = float((loss_pct / avg).min()) if avg else float(r.min())
141	        out["worst_window_vs_gain"] = {"worst_window": out["worst_window"], "validation_total_gain": float(validation_total_gain)}
142	        out["fails"] = bool(out["worst_trade_premiums"] < -5 or -out["worst_window"] > validation_total_gain)
143	    return out
144	
145	
146	def coded_checks(results, registry_count):
147	    """The 7 always-run Naysayer checks as {check, passed, value, note}."""
148	    plan = results["plan"]
149	    val, train = results["base"]["validation"], results["base"]["train"]
150	    out = []
151	    out.append({"check": "evidence", "passed": bool(val["n"] >= MIN_N and val["blocks"] >= MIN_BLOCKS),
152	                "value": {"n": val["n"], "blocks": val["blocks"]},
153	                "note": "validation needs n >= %d and at least %d distinct 10-trading-day blocks" % (MIN_N, MIN_BLOCKS)})
154	    dates_max = results.get("dates_max")
155	    out.append({"check": "leakage", "passed": True, "value": str(pd.Timestamp(dates_max).date()) if dates_max is not None else None,
156	                "note": "no feature or trade date after %s (earnings features exempt, see caveat)" % VALIDATION_END.date()})
157	    decay_ok = bool(val["mean"] > 0 and val["mean"] >= 0.5 * train["mean"])
158	    out.append({"check": "decay", "passed": decay_ok, "value": {"train_mean": train["mean"], "validation_mean": val["mean"]},
159	                "note": "validation mean %+.2f%% vs train mean %+.2f%%" % (100 * val["mean"], 100 * train["mean"])})
160	    out.append({"check": "shared_window", "passed": True, "value": int(registry_count),
161	                "note": "%d earlier audit(s) used this validation window. %s" % (registry_count, FIVE_PCT_LINE)})
162	    if plan["family"].startswith("straddle"):
163	        drops = results.get("drops", {}).get("validation", {})
164	        share = drops.get("earnings_in_window", 0) / val["n"] if val["n"] else 0.0
165	        stricter = results.get("stricter") or {}
166	        s_val = stricter.get("validation") if stricter else None
167	        passed = bool(s_val and s_val.get("ci_low", 0) > 0)
168	        out.append({"check": "cost_realism", "passed": passed,
169	                    "value": {"earnings_share": share, "stricter_ci_low": s_val.get("ci_low") if s_val else None},
170	                    "note": "%.0f%% of validation trades had earnings in the window (priced x1.20); stricter-cost lower bound %s"
171	                            % (100 * share, "%+.2f%%" % (100 * s_val["ci_low"]) if s_val else "n/a")})
172	    else:
173	        out.append({"check": "cost_realism", "passed": True, "value": None, "note": "stock_long: no fees or slippage modeled"})
174	    tail = results.get("tail") or {}
175	    out.append({"check": "tail_risk", "passed": not tail.get("fails", False),
176	                "value": {k: v for k, v in tail.items() if k != "fails"},
177	                "note": "worst trade %+.2f%%, worst 10-day window %+.2f%% (train plus validation)"
178	                        % (100 * tail.get("worst_trade", 0), 100 * tail.get("worst_window", 0))})
179	    out.append({"check": "data_drops", "passed": True, "value": results.get("drops", {}),
180	                "note": "setups dropped for exits past the cutoff or the data, stale implied vol, missing earnings coverage"})
181	    return out
182

1	"""Backtest (AUDITOR_SPEC section 2 trade rules, section 3 splits).
2	
3	stock_long: entry at the setup day's Adj Close; stop and target are absolute prices; Open/High/Low are
4	scaled to the Adj Close scale; a gap through the stop or target fills at the Open; otherwise the first-hit
5	rule with the stop first on a same-day double hit; no hit by the horizon exits at that day's Adj Close.
6	Straddles: hold 10 days, payoff on split-adjusted Close, cost from the ATM formula with the section 2
7	haircuts. One open trade per ticker; a new entry only after the previous trade has closed.
8	"""
9	import numpy as np
10	import pandas as pd
11	
12	from src.tools import matches
13	
14	TRAIN = ("2015-01-01", "2025-12-31")
15	STRADDLE_TRAIN_START = "2020-01-01"
16	VALID = ("2026-01-01", "2026-06-30")
17	CUTOFF = pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01")        # a train trade must exit before this
18	HOLD = 10
19	COST_K, BUY_HAIRCUT, EARNINGS_FACTOR, SELL_HAIRCUT = 0.7979, 1.05, 1.20, 0.95
20	STRICTER_BUY, STRICTER_SELL = 1.10, 0.90
21	TRADE_COLUMNS = ["ticker", "entry_date", "exit_date", "entry", "exit", "ret"]
22	
23	
24	def split_window(family, split):
25	    if split == "validation":
26	        return pd.Timestamp(VALID[0]), pd.Timestamp(VALID[1])
27	    if split == "train":
28	        start = STRADDLE_TRAIN_START if family.startswith("straddle") else TRAIN[0]
29	        return pd.Timestamp(start), pd.Timestamp(TRAIN[1])
30	    raise ValueError("unknown split %r (the test split is never constructed)" % split)
31	
32	
33	def select_setups(features, plan, split):
34	    """Rows in the split's window whose features satisfy the plan's conditions (NaN never matches)."""
35	    start, end = split_window(plan["family"], split)
36	    f = features[(features["date"] >= start) & (features["date"] <= end)]
37	    conds = plan["conditions"]
38	    if conds:
39	        f = f.dropna(subset=list(conds))
40	        f = f[matches(f, conds)]
41	    return f.sort_values(["ticker", "date"])
42	
43	
44	def _positions(df, dates):
45	    return df.index.get_indexer(pd.DatetimeIndex(dates))
46	
47	
48	def stock_long_trades(prices, features, plan, split, stricter=False):
49	    e = plan["exit"]
50	    horizon, target_pct, stop_pct = int(e["horizon_days"]), float(e["target_pct"]), float(e["stop_pct"])
51	    setups = select_setups(features, plan, split)
52	    rows, drops = [], {"exit_after_cutoff": 0, "exit_past_data": 0}
53	    for ticker, grp in setups.groupby("ticker", sort=True):
54	        df = prices[ticker]
55	        adj = df["Adj Close"].to_numpy(float)
56	        factor = adj / df["Close"].to_numpy(float)
57	        op, hi, lo = (df[c].to_numpy(float) * factor for c in ("Open", "High", "Low"))
58	        dates, n = df.index, len(df)
59	        open_until = -1
60	        for pos in _positions(df, grp["date"]):
61	            if pos < 0 or pos <= open_until:
62	                continue
63	            entry = adj[pos]
64	            stop, target = entry * (1 - stop_pct), entry * (1 + target_pct)
65	            exit_price = exit_pos = None
66	            for i in range(pos + 1, min(pos + horizon, n - 1) + 1):
67	                if op[i] <= stop or op[i] >= target:
68	                    exit_price, exit_pos = op[i], i
69	                elif lo[i] <= stop:
70	                    exit_price, exit_pos = stop, i
71	                elif hi[i] >= target:
72	                    exit_price, exit_pos = target, i
73	                if exit_pos is not None:
74	                    break
75	            if exit_pos is None:
76	                if pos + horizon >= n:
77	                    drops["exit_past_data"] += 1
78	                    continue
79	                exit_price, exit_pos = adj[pos + horizon], pos + horizon
80	            if split == "train" and dates[exit_pos] >= CUTOFF:
81	                drops["exit_after_cutoff"] += 1
82	                continue
83	            open_until = exit_pos
84	            rows.append({"ticker": ticker, "entry_date": dates[pos], "exit_date": dates[exit_pos],
85	                         "entry": float(entry), "exit": float(exit_price), "ret": float(exit_price / entry - 1)})
86	    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=TRADE_COLUMNS), drops
87	
88	
89	def straddle_trades(prices, features, plan, split, earnings, stricter=False):
90	    buyer = plan["family"] == "straddle_buy"
91	    setups = select_setups(features, plan, split)
92	    rows = []
93	    drops = {"exit_after_cutoff": 0, "exit_past_data": 0, "stale_iv": 0, "earnings_in_window": 0}
94	    for ticker, grp in setups.groupby("ticker", sort=True):
95	        df = prices[ticker]
96	        close = df["Close"].to_numpy(float)
97	        dates, n = df.index, len(df)
98	        earn_pos = set(int(p) for p in df.index.searchsorted(pd.DatetimeIndex(earnings.get(ticker) or [])))
99	        open_until = -1
100	        for pos, iv in zip(_positions(df, grp["date"]), grp["iv"].to_numpy(float)):
101	            if pos < 0 or pos <= open_until:
102	                continue
103	            if not np.isfinite(iv):
104	                drops["stale_iv"] += 1
105	                continue
106	            if pos + HOLD >= n:
107	                drops["exit_past_data"] += 1
108	                continue
109	            exit_pos = pos + HOLD
110	            if split == "train" and dates[exit_pos] >= CUTOFF:
111	                drops["exit_after_cutoff"] += 1
112	                continue
113	            open_until = exit_pos
114	            formula = COST_K * iv * np.sqrt(HOLD / 252)
115	            payoff = abs(close[exit_pos] / close[pos] - 1)
116	            has_earnings = any(pos < ep <= exit_pos for ep in earn_pos)
117	            row = {"ticker": ticker, "entry_date": dates[pos], "exit_date": dates[exit_pos],
118	                   "entry": float(close[pos]), "exit": float(close[exit_pos])}
119	            if buyer:
120	                cost = formula * BUY_HAIRCUT * (EARNINGS_FACTOR if has_earnings else 1.0) * (STRICTER_BUY if stricter else 1.0)
121	                drops["earnings_in_window"] += int(has_earnings)
122	                row.update(cost=float(cost), ret=float(payoff / cost - 1))
123	            else:
124	                premium = formula * SELL_HAIRCUT * (STRICTER_SELL if stricter else 1.0)
125	                drops["earnings_in_window"] += int(has_earnings)
126	                row.update(premium=float(premium), ret=float((premium - payoff) / premium))
127	            rows.append(row)
128	    cols = TRADE_COLUMNS + (["cost"] if buyer else ["premium"])
129	    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=cols), drops
130	
131	
132	def run_backtest(prices, features, plan, earnings, split, stricter=False):
133	    """-> (trades, drops) for the plan's family on one split."""
134	    if plan["family"] == "stock_long":
135	        return stock_long_trades(prices, features, plan, split, stricter)
136	    return straddle_trades(prices, features, plan, split, earnings, stricter)
137

1	"""Report template (AUDITOR_SPEC section 9). Code writes every number, the verdict, caveats and the
2	disclaimer; the Reporter's prose is optional and checked against a banned-phrase list."""
3	import json
4	from pathlib import Path
5	
6	from .checks import FIVE_PCT_LINE
7	from .plan import canonical
8	from .universe import GROUPS
9	
10	BANNED = ("will profit", "guaranteed", "risk-free", "we recommend", "you should buy", "you should sell", "sure thing")
11	SUBTITLES = {"promising": "Passed a 6-month historical screen. Not a forecast. Not financial advice.",
12	             "inconclusive": "inconclusive: a strategy with no real edge lands here about half the time"}
13	LABELS = {"kill": "KILLED", "inconclusive": "INCONCLUSIVE", "promising": "PROMISING", "cannot_audit": "CANNOT AUDIT"}
14	EARNINGS_CAVEAT = ("Earnings caveat: actual report dates are used; companies usually announce dates weeks ahead, "
15	                   "so the look-ahead is small but not zero.")
16	FOOTER = ("Not financial advice. Survivorship bias: the universe is today's large caps. One validation window "
17	          "(2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30) shared by every audit. Costs are approximated (no fees for stocks; "
18	          "straddle costs from an ATM formula with haircuts). No position sizing is given.")
19	
20	
21	def prose_ok(text):
22	    low = (text or "").lower()
23	    return not any(b in low for b in BANNED)
24	
25	
26	def pct(x):
27	    return "n/a" if x is None else "%+.2f%%" % (100 * x)
28	
29	
30	def _stats_row(label, s):
31	    if not s:
32	        return "| %s | – | – | – | – | – | – | – |" % label
33	    return "| %s | %d | %d | %.0f%% | %s | %s | [%s, %s] | %s / %s |" % (
34	        label, s["n"], s["blocks"], 100 * s["win_rate"], pct(s["mean"]), pct(s["median"]), pct(s["ci_low"]), pct(s["ci_high"]),
35	        pct(s["worst_trade"]), pct(s["worst_window"]))
36	
37	
38	def render(ctx):
39	    v = ctx["verdict"]
40	    plan = ctx["plan"]
41	    label = LABELS.get(v["verdict"], v["verdict"].upper())
42	    lines = ["# Strategy Auditor report: %s" % label, "", ctx["what_tested"], "",
43	             "## 1. What was tested and the verdict", "",
44	             "**Verdict: %s.** %s" % (label, v["reason"])]
45	    if v["verdict"] in SUBTITLES:
46	        lines.append("")
47	        lines.append("*%s*" % SUBTITLES[v["verdict"]])
48	    if ctx.get("small_group_note"):
49	        lines += ["", "Note: %s." % ctx["small_group_note"]]
50	    if ctx.get("fake_llm"):
51	        lines += ["", "**FAKE LLM run (development only): the plan and critique were produced by keyword rules, not a model.**"]
52	    if ctx.get("budget_hit"):
53	        lines += ["", "The LLM call cap (7 calls for the Planner and Naysayer) was hit; the verdict rests on the evidence gathered so far."]
54	    if ctx.get("fault_note"):
55	        lines += ["", ctx["fault_note"]]
56	    h = v.get("headline") or {}
57	    if h:
58	        lines += ["", "Headline: validation n = %s, mean per trade %s, lower bound %s, paired lower bound vs baseline %s."
59	                  % (h.get("n", "–"), pct(h.get("mean")), pct(h.get("ci_low")), pct(h.get("paired_ci_low")))]
60	
61	    lines += ["", "## 2. Idea, plan v0, assumptions", "", "Idea: %s" % ctx["idea"], "",
62	              "Plan v0 (frozen before any backtest), SHA-256 `%s`:" % ctx["plan_hash"], "", "```json",
63	              json.dumps(plan, indent=2, sort_keys=True), "```", ""]
64	    if plan.get("refused"):
65	        lines.append("Refused: %s" % plan.get("reason", ""))
66	    else:
67	        lines.append("Assumptions: " + ("; ".join(plan.get("assumptions") or []) or "none stated") + ".")
68	        lines.append("Not tested: " + ("; ".join(plan.get("not_tested") or []) or "nothing") + ".")
69	        if plan.get("universe_group") in GROUPS:
70	            lines.append("Universe: %s = %s." % (plan["universe_group"], ", ".join(GROUPS[plan["universe_group"]])))
71	
72	    cov, drops = ctx.get("coverage") or {}, ctx.get("drops") or {}
73	    lines += ["", "## 3. Data coverage", ""]
74	    if cov:
75	        rows = cov.get("rows_per_ticker_year") or {}
76	        if rows:
77	            years = sorted({y for r in rows.values() for y in r})
78	            lines += ["| Ticker | " + " | ".join(years) + " |", "|---|" + "---|" * len(years)]
79	            lines += ["| %s | %s |" % (t, " | ".join(str(r.get(y, 0)) for y in years)) for t, r in rows.items()]
80	            lines.append("")
81	        lines.append("Skipped tickers (under 200 rows): %s." % (", ".join(cov.get("skipped") or []) or "none"))
82	        if cov.get("iv_range"):
83	            lines.append("Implied vol rows: %d, %s to %s." % (cov["iv_rows"], *cov["iv_range"]))
84	        first = cov.get("earnings_first_date") or {}
85	        if first:
86	            lines.append("Earliest earnings date per ticker: " + ", ".join("%s %s" % kv for kv in sorted(first.items())) + ".")
87	        if cov.get("tickers_without_earnings"):
88	            lines.append("No earnings coverage: %s (NaN earnings features; left out of F1)." % ", ".join(cov["tickers_without_earnings"]))
89	    for split in ("train", "validation"):
90	        d = drops.get(split)
91	        if d:
92	            lines.append("Dropped %s setups: %s." % (split, ", ".join("%s %d" % kv for kv in d.items())))
93	    if ctx.get("earnings_caveat"):
94	        lines += ["", EARNINGS_CAVEAT]
95	
96	    lines += ["", "## 4. Results", "",
97	              "| Run | n | blocks | win | mean | median | 95% interval | worst trade / 10-day window |",
98	              "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
99	    base, bl = ctx.get("base") or {}, ctx.get("baseline") or {}
100	    lines.append(_stats_row("v0 train", base.get("train")))
101	    lines.append(_stats_row("v0 validation", base.get("validation")))
102	    lines.append(_stats_row("no-condition baseline, train", bl.get("train")))
103	    lines.append(_stats_row("no-condition baseline, validation", bl.get("validation")))
104	    rb = ctx.get("random_baseline") or {}
105	    if rb:
106	        lines.append(_stats_row("random selection at the same rate, validation (reported only)", rb.get("validation")))
107	    if ctx.get("stricter"):
108	        lines.append(_stats_row("stricter cost (+10% buyer / -10% seller), validation", ctx["stricter"].get("validation")))
109	    lines += ["", "Paired lower bound (v0 minus baseline, validation, 2.5th percentile): %s." % pct(bl.get("paired_ci_low"))]
110	    tail = ctx.get("tail") or {}
111	    if tail:
112	        extra = ""
113	        if "worst_trade_premiums" in tail:
114	            extra = " Seller losses: worst trade %.1f average premiums (%s of stock price); worst window %s vs total validation gain %s." % (
115	                tail["worst_trade_premiums"], pct(tail.get("worst_trade_pct")), pct(tail["worst_window"]),
116	                pct((tail.get("worst_window_vs_gain") or {}).get("validation_total_gain")))
117	        lines.append("Tail risk (train plus validation): worst trade %s, worst 10-trading-day window %s.%s" % (
118	            pct(tail.get("worst_trade")), pct(tail.get("worst_window")), extra))
119	
120	    lines += ["", "## 5. Coded checks and follow-ups", "", "| Check | Passed | Note |", "|---|---|---|"]
121	    lines += ["| %s | %s | %s |" % (c["check"], "yes" if c["passed"] else "no", c["note"]) for c in ctx.get("checks") or []]
122	    fus = ctx.get("followups") or []
123	    lines += ["", "Follow-ups: " + ("none run (M1)" if not fus else "")]
124	    for f in fus:
125	        lines.append("- %s: %s. Result: %s. %s" % (f["id"], f["reason"], f.get("result", "n/a"),
126	                                                 ("Downgrade: %s" % f["downgrade"]) if f.get("downgrade") else "No downgrade."))
127	    if v.get("downgrades"):
128	        lines += ["", "Downgrades: " + "; ".join(d["cause"] for d in v["downgrades"]) + "."]
129	
130	    lines += ["", "## 6. Shared validation window", "",
131	              "%d audit(s) have used this validation window before this one. %s" % (ctx.get("window_count", 0), FIVE_PCT_LINE)]
132	
133	    lines += ["", "## 7. Naysayer critique and Reporter prose", "", "Naysayer: %s" % (ctx.get("critique") or "n/a")]
134	    if ctx.get("prose"):
135	        lines += ["", "Reporter: %s" % ctx["prose"]]
136	    else:
137	        lines += ["", "Reporter prose: not included."]
138	
139	    lines += ["", "## 8. Recoveries", ""]
140	    recs = ctx.get("recoveries") or []
141	    lines += ["- [%s] %s: %s" % ("INJECTED" if r.get("injected") else "REAL", r["failed"], r["action"]) for r in recs] or ["none"]
142	
143	    cost = ctx.get("cost") or {}
144	    lines += ["", "## 9. Cost and trace", "",
145	              "LLM calls: %s (prompt tokens %s, completion tokens %s), cost $%.4f (upper bound). neatlogs trace: %s." % (
146	                  cost.get("calls", 0), cost.get("prompt_tokens", 0), cost.get("completion_tokens", 0), cost.get("usd", 0.0),
147	                  ctx.get("trace_id") or "none")]
148	    lines += ["", "## 10. Disclaimer", "", FOOTER, ""]
149	    return "\n".join(lines)
150	
151	
152	def append_registry(path, line):
153	    path = Path(path)
154	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
155	    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
156	        f.write(json.dumps(line, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
157	
158	
159	def registry_count(path):
160	    """Finished audits that used the shared validation window; fake-LLM development runs do not count."""
161	    path = Path(path)
162	    if not path.is_file():
163	        return 0
164	    n = 0
165	    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
166	        if not line.strip():
167	            continue
168	        try:
169	            if json.loads(line).get("provider") != "fake":
170	                n += 1
171	        except ValueError:
172	            continue
173	    return n
174	
175	
176	__all__ = ["render", "prose_ok", "append_registry", "registry_count", "canonical"]
177

1	"""A fake LLM for tests and development runs (AUDITOR_SPEC section 8: no real calls without a key).
2	
3	The Planner reply comes from keyword rules on the idea text; every reply is prefixed FAKE LLM so a report or
4	screen built from it can never pass as a model's work. Spans are recorded like real calls.
5	"""
6	import json
7	
8	from src.llm import PRICES
9	
10	FAKE_PREFIX = "FAKE LLM"
11	FAKE_MODEL = "fake"
12	TOKENS_IN, TOKENS_OUT = 1000, 100
13	
14	REFUSE_WORDS = ("manipulat", "insider", "pump", "non-public", "front-run", "spoof")
15	UNTESTABLE_WORDS = ("news", "sentiment", "tweet", "twitter", "reddit", "headline")
16	GROUP_WORDS = [("tech", "tech"), ("mega", "mega_cap"), ("financ", "financials"), ("bank", "financials"),
17	               ("health", "healthcare"), ("pharma", "healthcare"), ("energy", "energy"), ("oil", "energy"),
18	               ("consumer", "consumer"), ("retail", "consumer"), ("industrial", "industrials")]
19	CONDITION_WORDS = [
20	    ("earnings", "earnings_within_10d", ">=", 1, "'before earnings' read as an earnings report within the next 10 trading days"),
21	    ("low-vol", "vol_20d", "<", 0.012, "'low volatility' read as a 20-day daily volatility below 1.2%"),
22	    ("low volatility", "vol_20d", "<", 0.012, "'low volatility' read as a 20-day daily volatility below 1.2%"),
23	    ("low vol", "vol_20d", "<", 0.012, "'low volatility' read as a 20-day daily volatility below 1.2%"),
24	    ("dip", "ret_5d", "<", -0.03, "'dip' read as a 5-day return below -3%"),
25	    ("uptrend", "close_to_ma200", ">", 1.0, "'uptrend' read as close above its 200-day average"),
26	    ("momentum", "ret_20d", ">", 0.05, "'momentum' read as a 20-day return above +5%"),
27	    ("breakout", "ret_20d", ">", 0.05, "'breakout' read as a 20-day return above +5%"),
28	    ("oversold", "ret_10d", "<", -0.05, "'oversold' read as a 10-day return below -5%"),
29	]
30	
31	
32	def plan_from_idea(idea):
33	    low = idea.lower()
34	    base = {"refuse": {"is_refused": False, "reason": ""}, "family": "stock_long", "universe_group": "all_50",
35	            "conditions": [], "exit": {"target_pct": 0.05, "stop_pct": 0.03, "horizon_days": 10},
36	            "hypothesis": "%s: %s" % (FAKE_PREFIX, idea), "assumptions": [], "not_tested": [], "core_trigger_tested": True}
37	    if any(w in low for w in REFUSE_WORDS):
38	        base["refuse"] = {"is_refused": True, "reason": "%s: market manipulation or non-public information" % FAKE_PREFIX}
39	        return base
40	    if "straddle" in low:
41	        base["family"] = "straddle_sell" if "sell" in low else "straddle_buy"
42	    for word, group in GROUP_WORDS:
43	        if word in low:
44	            base["universe_group"] = group
45	            break
46	    seen = set()
47	    for word, feature, op, value, reading in CONDITION_WORDS:
48	        if word in low and feature not in seen:
49	            seen.add(feature)
50	            base["conditions"].append({"feature": feature, "op": op, "value": value})
51	            base["assumptions"].append(reading)
52	    if any(w in low for w in UNTESTABLE_WORDS):
53	        base["core_trigger_tested"] = False
54	        base["not_tested"] = ["news sentiment"]
55	        base["assumptions"].append("the trigger (news or sentiment) cannot be expressed with the available features")
56	    if not base["assumptions"]:
57	        base["assumptions"].append("%s: no keyword matched; enter every day of the group" % FAKE_PREFIX)
58	    return base
59	
60	
61	def make_fake_llm(tracer):
62	    """Same signature as src.llm.make_llm's result: llm(agent, system, prompt, schema, **tags)."""
63	    price_in, price_out = PRICES["deepseek-flash"]
64	
65	    def llm(agent, system, prompt, schema, **tags):
66	        with tracer.span("llm", agent, model=FAKE_MODEL, **tags) as rec:
67	            rec["input"] = prompt
68	            rec["prompt_tokens"], rec["completion_tokens"] = TOKENS_IN, TOKENS_OUT
69	            rec["cost"] = (TOKENS_IN * price_in + TOKENS_OUT * price_out) / 1e6
70	            rec["attempts"] = 1
71	            if agent == "planner":
72	                body = json.loads(prompt)
73	                out = plan_from_idea(body.get("idea", ""))
74	            elif agent == "naysayer":
75	                ctx = json.loads(prompt) if prompt.startswith("{") else {}
76	                val = ((ctx.get("base") or {}).get("validation") or {})
77	                out = {"critique": "%s: the validation mean is %s over %s trades; read the coded checks, not this sentence."
78	                                   % (FAKE_PREFIX, val.get("mean", "n/a"), val.get("n", "n/a")),
79	                       "doubts": ["%s: one validation window" % FAKE_PREFIX, "%s: costs are approximated" % FAKE_PREFIX]}
80	            elif agent == "reporter":
81	                out = {"prose": "%s: template explanation. The verdict rests on the numbers above." % FAKE_PREFIX}
82	            else:
83	                raise ValueError("fake llm has no role %r" % agent)
84	            rec["output"] = json.dumps(out)
85	            return out
86	
87	    return llm
88	
89	
90	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- client-level fakes and faults
91	
92	class FakeAuditorClient:
93	    """Stands in for OpenAI(base_url=DeepSeek) for the auditor's roles, so src.llm.make_llm's retry path is
94	    exercised for real. `queued` maps a role (planner/naysayer/reporter) to reply texts sent before the default."""
95	
96	    def __init__(self, queued=None):
97	        from types import SimpleNamespace
98	        self.queued = {k: list(v) for k, v in (queued or {}).items()}
99	        self.requests = []
100	        self.chat = SimpleNamespace(completions=SimpleNamespace(create=self._create))
101	
102	    @staticmethod
103	    def _role(system):
104	        for role in ("planner", "naysayer", "reporter"):
105	            if "You are the %s" % role.capitalize() in system:
106	                return role
107	        raise ValueError("unknown role in system prompt")
108	
109	    def _create(self, **kwargs):
110	        from types import SimpleNamespace
111	        self.requests.append(kwargs)
112	        system, user = kwargs["messages"][0]["content"], kwargs["messages"][1]["content"]
113	        role = self._role(system)
114	        queue = self.queued.get(role)
115	        if queue:
116	            text = queue.pop(0)
117	        elif role == "planner":
118	            text = json.dumps(plan_from_idea(json.loads(user).get("idea", "")))
119	        elif role == "naysayer":
120	            text = json.dumps({"critique": "%s: see the coded checks." % FAKE_PREFIX, "doubts": ["%s: one window" % FAKE_PREFIX]})
121	        else:
122	            text = json.dumps({"prose": "%s: template explanation." % FAKE_PREFIX})
123	        return SimpleNamespace(choices=[SimpleNamespace(message=SimpleNamespace(content=text), finish_reason="stop")],
124	                               usage=SimpleNamespace(prompt_tokens=TOKENS_IN, completion_tokens=TOKENS_OUT))
125	
126	
127	class EmptyFirstReply:
128	    """Wraps a real OpenAI-style client so the first reply's content is empty (`--fault llm_empty`, section 6).
129	    The wrapper's own retry in src.llm then recovers; the audit labels that recovery INJECTED."""
130	
131	    def __init__(self, client):
132	        from types import SimpleNamespace
133	        self._client, self._fired = client, False
134	        self.chat = SimpleNamespace(completions=SimpleNamespace(create=self._create))
135	
136	    def _create(self, **kwargs):
137	        resp = self._client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
138	        if not self._fired:
139	            self._fired = True
140	            resp.choices[0].message.content = ""
141	        return resp

"""Strategy Auditor CLI (AUDITOR_SPEC section 9).

    python -m src.auditor "buy straddles on tech stocks before earnings"
    python -m src.auditor --id <audit_id> "<idea>"            # used by the server (section 16)
    python -m src.auditor --resume <audit_id>
    python -m src.auditor --fault dolthub_timeout "<idea>"    # or --fault llm_empty (section 6)
    python -m src.auditor --provider fake "<idea>"            # keyword fake LLM: development only

DeepSeek runs refuse to start when the account balance is below $2 (section 8).
"""
import argparse
import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import secrets
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from .data import IV_END, _fetch_window, _http_query, fetch_earnings, fetch_implied_vol, fetch_prices
from .fake_llm import EmptyFirstReply, make_fake_llm
from .run import run_audit

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BALANCE_URL = "https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance"
MIN_BALANCE = 2.0


def _http_get_json(url, headers):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
        return json.load(r)


def deepseek_balance(get=None):
    """Total USD balance from DeepSeek's balance API, or None when the key is missing or the call fails."""
    key = os.environ.get("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY")
    if not key:
        return None
    try:
        d = (get or _http_get_json)(BALANCE_URL, {"Authorization": "Bearer " + key})
        return float(d["balance_infos"][0]["total_balance"])
    except Exception:
        return None


def make_fetchers(fault):
    """The real data tools. `--fault dolthub_timeout` probes one DoltHub window with a query that times out once,
    so the retry (and its recovered event) is real even when the implied-vol cache is already warm."""
    def iv(tickers, cache_dir, on_recovered=None, fault_first_timeout=False, **kw):
        if fault_first_timeout:
            state = {"fired": False}

            def probe(sql):
                if not state["fired"]:
                    state["fired"] = True
                    raise TimeoutError("injected DoltHub timeout")
                return _http_query(sql)

            b = pd.Timestamp(IV_END)
            _fetch_window(list(tickers), b - pd.Timedelta(days=13), b, probe, time.sleep, on_recovered)
        return fetch_implied_vol(tickers, cache_dir, on_recovered=on_recovered)

    return {"prices": fetch_prices, "iv": iv, "earnings": fetch_earnings}


def new_audit_id():
    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S") + "-" + secrets.token_hex(2)


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m src.auditor", description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument("idea", nargs="?", help="the trading idea in plain English")
    ap.add_argument("--id", dest="audit_id", help="audit id (default: timestamp)")
    ap.add_argument("--resume", metavar="AUDIT_ID", help="continue an interrupted audit")
    ap.add_argument("--fault", choices=["dolthub_timeout", "llm_empty"], help="inject one failure (labelled INJECTED)")
    ap.add_argument("--provider", default="deepseek", choices=["deepseek", "claude", "fake"])
    ap.add_argument("--no-balance-check", action="store_true", help="skip the DeepSeek balance check")
    ap.add_argument("--root", default=str(REPO / "runs" / "audits"))
    ap.add_argument("--cache", default=str(REPO / "data" / "cache"))
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.idea and not args.resume:
        ap.error("give an idea, or --resume <audit_id>")

    try:
        from dotenv import load_dotenv
        load_dotenv(REPO / ".env")
    except ImportError:
        pass

    if args.fault == "llm_empty" and args.provider != "deepseek":
        print("--fault llm_empty is only wired for the deepseek provider (it blanks the first real reply); "
              "nothing would be injected with --provider %s." % args.provider)
        return 2

    if args.provider == "deepseek" and not args.no_balance_check:
        balance = deepseek_balance()
        if balance is None:
            print("DeepSeek balance unknown (no DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or the balance API failed). Check it by hand and "
                  "re-run with --no-balance-check, or use --provider fake for development.")
            return 2
        if balance < MIN_BALANCE:
            print("DeepSeek balance $%.2f is below $%.2f: top up before a real audit (section 8)." % (balance, MIN_BALANCE))
            return 2

    from src.tracing import make_tracer
    tracer = make_tracer(tags=("strategy-auditor", "provider:" + args.provider))
    if args.provider == "fake":
        llm = make_fake_llm(tracer)
    else:
        from src.llm import make_llm
        client = None
        if args.fault == "llm_empty":
            from openai import OpenAI
            client = EmptyFirstReply(OpenAI(api_key=os.environ["DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"], base_url="https://api.deepseek.com"))
        llm = make_llm(tracer, args.provider, client)

    audit_id = args.resume or args.audit_id or new_audit_id()
    out = run_audit(args.idea or "", audit_id, llm, tracer, root=Path(args.root), cache_dir=Path(args.cache),
                    fetchers=make_fetchers(args.fault), fault=args.fault, resume=bool(args.resume), provider=args.provider)
    tracer.flush()
    v = out["verdict"]
    print("audit %s" % audit_id)
    print("verdict: %s (%s)" % (v["verdict"], v["reason"]))
    print("report: %s" % out["report_path"])
    print("events: %s" % out["events_path"])
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Audit event contract (AUDITOR_SPEC.md section 16).

One JSON object per line in runs/audits/<audit_id>/events.jsonl:
{"seq", "ts", "audit_id", "type", "agent", "payload"}. `agent` is null for audit-level events.
"""

AGENTS = frozenset({"planner", "researcher", "mathematician", "naysayer", "reporter", "triage"})

TOP_LEVEL = ("seq", "ts", "audit_id", "type", "agent", "payload")

# type -> required payload fields, copied from the section 16 table.
EVENT_TYPES = {
    "audit_started": ("idea", "trace_id", "llm_budget", "fault"),
    "agent_started": ("step",),
    "agent_finished": ("step", "status", "duration_ms", "summary"),
    "llm_call": ("model", "prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens", "cost_usd", "latency_ms"),
    "tool_called": ("tool", "args"),
    "tool_result": ("tool", "ok", "duration_ms", "summary"),
    "data_progress": ("what", "percent"),
    "backtest_result": ("run", "train", "validation", "baseline",
                        "equity_train", "equity_validation", "histogram"),
    "check_result": ("check", "passed", "value", "note"),
    "followup_requested": ("followup", "reason"),
    "recovered": ("failed", "action", "injected"),
    "verdict": ("verdict", "reason", "headline", "downgrades"),
    "report_ready": ("path", "trace_id", "prose_included"),
    "error": ("step", "message"),
}


def validate_event(obj):
    """Return a list of problems; an empty list means the event is valid."""
    if not isinstance(obj, dict):
        return ["event is not an object"]
    problems = ["missing key %r" % k for k in TOP_LEVEL if k not in obj]
    if problems:
        return problems
    if not isinstance(obj["seq"], int) or isinstance(obj["seq"], bool):
        problems.append("seq must be an integer")
    if not isinstance(obj["ts"], str):
        problems.append("ts must be a string")
    if obj["agent"] is not None and obj["agent"] not in AGENTS:
        problems.append("unknown agent %r" % (obj["agent"],))
    if obj["type"] not in EVENT_TYPES:
        problems.append("unknown type %r" % (obj["type"],))
    elif not isinstance(obj["payload"], dict):
        problems.append("payload must be an object")
    else:
        problems += ["payload of %s missing %r" % (obj["type"], f)
                     for f in EVENT_TYPES[obj["type"]] if f not in obj["payload"]]
    return problems

"""Synthetic markets and fake Claude clients for the swarm tests. No network, no data files."""
import contextlib
import json
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pandas as pd

from src.features import FEATURE_NAMES
from src.tools import Market


def make_market(closes_by_ticker, setups, start="2025-01-01"):
    """closes_by_ticker: {ticker: [close, ...]}; High = Low = close unless edited after.
    setups: list of (ticker, row_index, split, label[, features dict])."""
    prices = {}
    for ticker, closes in closes_by_ticker.items():
        dates = pd.bdate_range(start, periods=len(closes), name="Date")
        prices[ticker] = pd.DataFrame({"Adj Close": closes, "High": closes, "Low": closes},
                                      index=dates, dtype=float)
    rows = []
    for s in setups:
        ticker, i, split, label = s[:4]
        feats = {k: 0.0 for k in FEATURE_NAMES}
        feats.update(s[4] if len(s) > 4 else {})
        rows.append({"ticker": ticker, "date": prices[ticker].index[i].date().isoformat(),
                     "split": split, "label": label, **feats})
    return Market(prices, pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["ticker", "date", "split", "label"] + FEATURE_NAMES))


def set_bar(market, ticker, i, high=None, low=None):
    df = market.prices[ticker]
    if high is not None:
        df.iloc[i, df.columns.get_loc("High")] = high
    if low is not None:
        df.iloc[i, df.columns.get_loc("Low")] = low
    market.__post_init__()      # rebuild the numpy arrays


RESEARCHER_OUT = {"facts": [{"key": "ret_5d", "statement": "5-day return is 0."},
                            {"key": "vol_20d", "statement": "20-day volatility is 0."}]}
PLAN_OUT = {"thesis": "Momentum continues.",
            "conditions": [{"feature": "ret_5d", "op": ">=", "value": 0.0}],
            "facts_cited": ["ret_5d"]}


def fake_llm(planner=PLAN_OUT, naysayer=None, researcher=RESEARCHER_OUT):
    """An llm callable for agents. Each response is a dict or a function of the call number."""
    responses = {"researcher": researcher, "planner": planner,
                 "naysayer": naysayer or {"verdict": "approve", "objections": []}}
    calls = []

    def llm(agent, system, prompt, schema, **tags):
        calls.append({"agent": agent, "prompt": prompt, "tags": tags})
        r = responses[agent]
        n = sum(c["agent"] == agent for c in calls)
        return r(n) if callable(r) else r

    llm.calls = calls
    return llm


def _answers():
    return {"Researcher": RESEARCHER_OUT, "Planner": PLAN_OUT,
            "Naysayer": {"verdict": "approve", "objections": []}}


def _role(system, answers):
    return next(r for r in answers if "You are the %s" % r in system)


class FakeClient:
    """Stands in for anthropic.Anthropic(): answers by agent, read from the system prompt."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.answers = _answers()
        self.requests = []
        self.messages = SimpleNamespace(create=self._create)
        self.beta = SimpleNamespace(messages=SimpleNamespace(create=self._create))

    def _create(self, **kwargs):
        self.requests.append(kwargs)
        text = json.dumps(self.answers[_role(kwargs["system"], self.answers)])
        return SimpleNamespace(
            stop_reason="end_turn",
            usage=SimpleNamespace(input_tokens=1000, output_tokens=100),
            content=[SimpleNamespace(type="text", text=text)])


class FakeDeepSeekClient:
    """Stands in for OpenAI(base_url=DeepSeek). `queued` maps a role to replies sent before the default."""

    def __init__(self, queued=None, finish_reason="stop"):
        self.answers = _answers()
        self.queued = {k: list(v) for k, v in (queued or {}).items()}
        self.finish_reason = finish_reason
        self.requests = []
        self.chat = SimpleNamespace(completions=SimpleNamespace(create=self._create))

    def _create(self, **kwargs):
        self.requests.append(kwargs)
        role = _role(kwargs["messages"][0]["content"], self.answers)
        queue = self.queued.get(role)

"""Score Laya on the validation split, measured the same way as src/baselines.py.

Self-contained (needs only laya, numpy, scikit-learn) so it can be uploaded to Kaggle as one file.
Scores the original model (zero-shot) and the fine-tuned checkpoint side by side.

On Kaggle (GPU on, internet on, laya installed, the fine-tuned model in /kaggle/working):
    !python /kaggle/input/<dataset>/score_laya.py \
        --data /kaggle/input/<dataset>/laya_validation.jsonl \
        --models convaiinnovations/laya /kaggle/working/laya_finetuned

Locally: python src/score_laya.py --models convaiinnovations/laya runs/checkpoints/laya_finetuned

Prints a table and writes laya_validation_scores.json (all predictions) next to --out.
"""

import os

import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import brier_score_loss, log_loss, roc_auc_score

}

def read_rows(path):

        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]
